0022600024.text: The Denver Nuggets (1-2, 1-1 at home, 0-1 on the road) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-2, 1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, with Denver fourth in the Northwest, 2.5 games back, and 10th in the West, while Phoenix sits second in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 11th in the West. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), while Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and is a game-time decision. There are no 2026-27 games between the teams yet, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 125-123 win in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
